name: Smart Truck (AD2 kit)
description: A commercial-vehicle ADAS kit: forward camera, radar, compute box, driver display and harness.
signalChain: Camera and radar watch the forward path and the blind quarters
SoC2 fuses both into one object list with range and closing speed
Collision, lane and blind-spot logic decide whether to warn
Driver is warned, and the brake interface is signalled where fitted
role: Forty percent of group revenue from one SKU. That is the concentration to underwrite, also why the portfolio has a demand floor rather than a forecast.
dependsOn: AIS-mandate compliance, installation channel capacity, and radar verification milestones.

name: AD0 Smart Mirror
description: A replacement mirror unit with an integrated display, four body cameras and a wiring loom.
signalChain: Four cameras cover the vehicle's blind quarters
SoC2 stitches the views into one 360° surround image
Proximity and motion logic flags anything entering the danger zone
Driver sees the stitched view and hears a directional alert
role: Volume ramp of the portfolio: highest unit count and lowest fitment complexity, scales channel reach that harder products inherit.
dependsOn: Distribution reach and price holding at ₹50k. Runs on current-generation hardware, not gated on the ASIC.

name: Autonomous TaaS
description: Not a product sold to a customer: a vehicle we own, operated under contract on a fixed route.
signalChain: The vehicle's full sensor set reads a route we have already surveyed
SoC2 runs the autonomy stack against that route model
Fleet logic schedules, routes and hands off to a remote operator when needed
The vehicle drives, and the customer is billed per trip or per tonne
role: Highest revenue per unit we sell. Proof that the same silicon running in a kit can run an entire operation.
dependsOn: Regulatory clearance for autonomous operation in controlled corridors.

name: Chipset OEM B2B
description: The bare SoC2 die, supplied in tray or reel for the customer to place on their own board.
signalChain: The customer's own sensors feed their own board
The SoC2 die does the perception compute inside their design
Their software decides what to do with the result
Their product ships, with our silicon inside it
role: Fifty-four crore at ninety-four percent gross margin, the highest in the portfolio. Every rupee arrives without installation capacity or warranty logistics.

name: T100 AI Licence
description: Not hardware: a licence to the trained perception models and the toolchain around them.
signalChain: The customer runs their own hardware and their own sensors
Our models do the perception work inside their runtime
Their system decides and acts
They ship under their own brand, with our perception inside
role: Pure software revenue at 94% margin. Converts the IP investment in Indian road models into a recurring stream independent of hardware.
dependsOn: Maturity of the Indian road perception stack, starts FY29.

name: AD1 Indoor L4 Kit
description: A self-driving retrofit kit for indoor vehicles: sensor head, compute box and a drive-by-wire interface.
signalChain: Cameras and depth sensing read the aisle, load and people
SoC2 localises the vehicle against a site map it holds onboard
Planner picks a path and a speed for the geofenced route
Drive-by-wire interface issues steer, throttle and brake
role: Where L4 behaviour ships years before it is legal on a public road, the technical proof point for the road roadmap.
dependsOn: Site mapping and commissioning throughput, services capacity rather than product.

name: A100 Compute Box 4ch PCIe
description: A PCIe card carrying the SoC2 with four camera inputs, for a host system.
signalChain: Four cameras give full surround coverage
The card runs perception across all four streams
Results go to the host over PCIe
The host system builds its own product on top
role: The highest-capacity compute form factor, serves customers who need multi-camera perception without building their own board.
dependsOn: ASIC tapeout and PCIe interface validation.

name: Defence D-HUMR
description: An unmanned ground vehicle for defence logistics and reconnaissance.
signalChain: Surround sensing reads terrain, obstacles and people
SoC2 builds a local map and plans a traversable route
Autonomy drives, with a teleoperator able to take control
Mission payload does its job at the destination
role: Highest price point in the portfolio, opens defence procurement channel and validates ruggedised silicon.
dependsOn: Defence procurement cycle and security clearances.

name: A100 Compute Box 2ch
description: A board-level compute module with two camera inputs and the SDK.
signalChain: Two cameras cover a wider field or a stereo pair
The board runs perception on both streams on one SoC2
Fused output is returned to the customer's application
Their system acts on it
role: Mid-tier compute module serving stereo vision applications.

name: A100 Compute Box 1ch M.2
description: An M.2 module carrying the SoC2, sized to drop into a customer's existing carrier board.
signalChain: One camera feeds the customer's carrier board
The M.2 module runs their model on the SoC2
Results return over the bus to their application
Their product acts on the output
role: Entry-level compute module, lowest-cost path to adding DeepGrid perception to an existing product.

name: Seaport AGV
description: An autonomous container-yard vehicle operating inside a port perimeter.
signalChain: Surround sensing reads containers, cranes, lanes and people in the yard
SoC2 localises against the yard map and tracks moving obstacles
Planner sequences the pick, the move and the drop against the yard schedule
The vehicle executes and reports back to the terminal system
role: Second-highest revenue per unit after TaaS, validates the silicon in port infrastructure.

name: D100 Drone SoC Kit
description: A flight-capable compute and perception kit for an airframe builder.
signalChain: Cameras and IMU read the scene and the airframe's own motion
SoC2 runs perception and visual odometry in flight
Planner produces waypoints or avoidance manoeuvres
The flight controller executes them
role: Opens aerial perception as a silicon market, same die, different firmware.

name: Thermal Camera Pod
description: A bolt-on long-wave infrared camera pod with its own lens and heater, feeding the existing compute box.
signalChain: The LWIR sensor reads emitted heat rather than reflected light
SoC2 runs detection on the thermal image, where a person is bright against cold road
Classification separates people and animals from roadside clutter
Detections join the same object list the cameras feed
role: The perception layer that enables night and monsoon operation, differentiator for the Smart Truck kit.
dependsOn: LWIR sensor sourcing and calibration pipeline.

name: H100 Driver Monitor
description: A wrist-worn band with an on-body sensor set and a radio link to the vehicle.
signalChain: The band reads pulse and movement continuously on the driver
An on-device model scores alertness without sending raw data anywhere
A drowsiness state crosses a threshold
The vehicle alert chain warns the driver and the fleet is notified
role: Highest volume sensor SKU, mandate requires it in every commercial vehicle.

name: 4D Radar Pod
description: A sealed radar pod, mounted forward or on the corner, feeding the compute box.
signalChain: The radar illuminates the scene and reads the returns
The R100 block on the die turns returns into range, velocity and elevation
Tracks are formed and held across frames, including through rain and dust
Tracks fuse with the camera object list to confirm or reject detections
role: Radar matters because closing speed is what a braking decision actually turns on, camera alone cannot measure it.
dependsOn: Radar block verification on the ASIC.
